hollowzinho.description: A Hollow pet for VS Code: it looks where you type, eats reiatsu from your code, reacts to errors, tests and commits, and fires a Cero at the line you are on.
hollowzinho.cfg.name: The pet's name.
hollowzinho.cfg.tint: Color of the markings and aura.
hollowzinho.cfg.language: Language of the bubbles. "auto" follows VS Code.
hollowzinho.cfg.size: Pet size in pixels. 0 picks one that fits the view.
hollowzinho.cfg.scene: The little window into Hueco Mundo behind the pet.
hollowzinho.cfg.chatter: How often the pet talks on its own.
hollowzinho.cfg.sleepAfter: Minutes without typing until the pet falls asleep. 0 never.
hollowzinho.cfg.reactToEditing: Typing feeds the pet and its eyes follow your cursor; saving with Ctrl+S makes it happy.
hollowzinho.cfg.reactToDiagnostics: Each error becomes a little bug in the pet's view; the pet worries when they appear and shoots them when you fix them.
hollowzinho.cfg.reactToTasks: The pet reacts when a task or a build/test command in the terminal ends.
hollowzinho.cfg.reactToGit: A commit is food, a push is a party and a new branch is a walk.
hollowzinho.cfg.editorEffects: When the pet fires a Cero, flash the line you are on in the editor.
hollowzinho.cfg.statusBar: Show the pet's reiatsu in the status bar.
hollowzinho.cfg.editorSide: Which side of the pet the editor is on. "auto" follows the side bar position: the Cero leaves that way and the pet looks that way.
hollowzinho.color.ceroCore: Border and ruler mark of the line the Cero hits in the editor.
hollowzinho.cfg.bugs: Draw a little bug in the pet's view for each error (up to 6). Turn off to keep only the pet's reactions.
hollowzinho.cfg.autoCero: When the pet fires a Cero on its own.
hollowzinho.cfg.autoCero.off: Never: it only fires when you ask (command, click on a bug, Quick Fix, hold on the pet).
hollowzinho.cfg.autoCero.exceptions: On an exception stopped in the debugger.
hollowzinho.cfg.autoCero.newErrors: On every new error, and on exceptions. The line flashes without moving your cursor.
hollowzinho.cfg.reactToDebug: The pet follows debugging: hunter mode while a session runs, pause at breakpoints, a scare on exceptions.
hollowzinho.cfg.reactToWorkspace: Files created or deleted from VS Code, and a greeting when you come back to the window after a long time.
hollowzinho.cfg.quickFix: Add "Hollowzinho: Cero at this error" to the Quick Fix menu of errors.
